method: OpenAI built-in image generation; model revision not exposed
contextualAlt: Three ink-drawn panels show a practitioner recording a question at a closed door, comparing evidence with a modeller and architectural study, then hearing a reviewer's challenge beside two preserved sources.
lightPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: OPDA semantic-modelling section header for /semantic-modelling/method/from-question-to-candidate.
Primary request: Create ONE original wide 3:1 three-panel sequential ink narrative for adults. It tells a restrained left-to-right progression from question, through comparison, to constructive challenge. Use a completely different cast and staging from any earlier image. The recurring practitioner is a slim middle-aged South Asian man with close-cropped black hair, neat moustache, mustard-gold field coat and petrol satchel. The recurring modeller is a young East Asian woman with a chin-length straight black bob, round dark glasses and coral overshirt. The reviewer is an older Black man with a close grey beard, shaved head and violet cardigan. Preserve each person's face, clothing, proportions and identity whenever they recur in this strip.
Scene/backdrop: grounded British property-inspection and modelling work on cool off-white #F9F9F9 paper to every edge. Use a more graphic side-on, shallow stage-like composition than a conventional meeting scene, with restrained architectural details and no decorative abstraction.
Panel one: in profile at a real inspection-area doorway inside a modest dwelling, the mustard-coated practitioner stands beside a clearly closed door and records a question in a small open field notebook using only broad unreadable strokes; his posture and gaze clearly connect the practical uncertainty to that closed doorway. No other person in this first moment.
Panel two: at a narrow drafting desk, that same practitioner and the coral-shirted modeller compare his field notebook and ONE separate evidence folio with purely pictorial blank marks, beside a small physical architectural study model of the doorway and adjoining wall. Keep the notebook/evidence visibly separate from the model. They are considering what description could answer the question, not operating software.
Panel three: at the same shallow work setting, the violet-cardigan reviewer challenges the proposed description on a separate draft sheet, pointing thoughtfully while presenting a clearly contrasting SECOND original source folio from his own hand. The practitioner and modeller listen. Preserve BOTH original sources as visibly separate artefacts on the table, along with the provisional description; nothing is stamped or approved. Expressions are serious, curious and provisional rather than celebratory.
Style/medium: sophisticated independent-magazine ink narrative; crisp varied-width brush-and-pen contours, some confident angular dry-brush hatching, and flat pastel opaque gouache shapes. Adult editorial illustration, observational and architectural, NOT watercolour, not caricature, not a children's cartoon, not superhero comic art.
Composition/framing: exact full 3:1 panoramic canvas, three equal shallow panels read left to right, separated by thin simple deep-purple #231F2F gutters. A low side-on viewpoint with strong lateral silhouettes; full people, full heads, important hands and complete props inside the frame; no huge blank margins. Crisp and legible at 1200x400. Make this visually distinct from a front-facing two-person desk comic.
Color palette: cool off-white #F9F9F9 paper, deep-purple ink #231F2F, generous flat OPDA gold #FEC92B, petrol #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4 and restrained coral accents. No beige or sepia cast.
Meaning constraints: the closed doorway is a real inspection-area boundary; the small architectural object is a study model, not an actual source. The contrasting sources remain intact and separate. The proposed description is provisional and challenged. The illustration is fictional teaching art, not evidence. Do not suggest approval, a final answer, consensus, truth, a live application or an automatic source-to-model pipeline.
Text constraints: absolutely NO embedded text of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, signage, speech bubbles, icons, symbols or arrows. All paper marks must be loose non-semantic strokes or simple pictorial areas, never readable glyphs.
Avoid: green ticks, checkmarks, approval stamps, logos, watermarks, floating nodes, linked-network motifs, glow, neon, gradients, photography, glossy 3D, UI chrome, giant empty margins, extra people, extra panels, duplicated limbs or malformed hands. Full artwork only.
darkPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: exact dark-mode counterpart of the supplied approved light OPDA sequential ink narrative header.
Input image: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve it exactly; do not reinterpret or regenerate its story.
Primary request: change ONLY the paper, ink values and flat gouache pigment treatment so the supplied illustration works on a dark surface. The entire paper background across all three panels becomes one flat deep purple #231F2F to every outer edge.
Exact invariants: preserve pixel-for-pixel-equivalent composition and geometry: identical three panels, thin gutters, recurring practitioner, modeller and reviewer, their identities, faces, hair, facial hair, glasses, clothes, poses, hands, expressions and actions; identical closed doorway, notebook, satchel, drafting desk, evidence folios, small architectural doorway study, proposed description sheet, plants, furniture and every other prop; identical object count, positions, sizes, proportions, perspective, framing, crop and negative-space balance. Do not add, remove, move, resize, redraw or replace any subject or object.
Dark palette: retain rich flat OPDA gold #FEC92B, petrol #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4 and restrained coral accents as opaque pastel gouache. Convert dark original linework to pale lavender, warm off-white or carefully chosen pale coloured ink where needed for excellent legibility. Leave the deep-purple paper visible between pen strokes and pigment fields. Maintain crisp varied-width brush-and-pen contours, angular dry-brush hatching and sophisticated adult editorial character.
Critical treatment: this is a careful dark-paper recolouring of the exact same drawing, not night scenery and not a colour inversion. Pigments may be vivid and readable but never fluorescent and never glowing.
Constraints: absolutely no redesign, additions, removals, rearrangement, new marks, new story, new setting, night scenery, stars, moon, negative-image effect, neon, fluorescent outline, glow, gradients, photography, glossy 3D, UI chrome, embedded text, words, letters, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, signs, symbols, arrows, logos or watermarks. Keep the exact full shallow 3:1 strip and thin simple gutters unchanged.

export.operation: Whole-image proportional contain on a theme-colour 1200x400 canvas; no crop or stretching.
